description: A Jenga-style wooden block tower sits on the table, with a few loose blocks scattered behind it near the curtain. The left hand reaches toward the loose blocks and picks one up briefly while the right hand lifts a block from the tabletop, moves it over the tower, and carefully sets it onto the top layer, then reaches again to place another block on top; the left hand stays nearby without touching the tower as the right-hand object is placed and released.
